name: Komugi Rere
source:
A younger shrine maiden who, along with Chihiro, works part-time at Kanda Shrine. Her nickname is Rerepi.
She usually dresses like a gal (Japanese subculture, aka "gyaru") and, even toward the shy and reserved Chihiro, she tries to be friendly by cheerfully talking on and on at a very close distance.
She also speaks like a gal and throws in her own unique slang that uses prefixes like "mega," "giga," and "tera" in place of words like "super" or "crazy."

[From in-game profile]
